card.name: End of Spanish institution name words
card.fires_on: The last syllable or word of a Spanish, Portuguese or Italian noun inside an institution, lab or event name, right where a 'de' or 'del' linking word would come next.

modes.label: Word ends before 'de'
modes.description: Final piece of a Spanish noun like ecología or economía in a lab or conference name, where 'de' follows.
modes.example: 1 Laboratorio de Ec<<ología>> de Poblaciones, Centro de Investig

modes.label: Other Romance name parts
modes.description: Words inside place or organization names in Spanish, Portuguese or Italian, before a linking word.
modes.example: Giornate Europee del Cinema<< e>> dell'Audiovisivo 20

card.writes: It promotes 'de', 'der', 'del' and similar linking words, and suppresses capitalised 'De' forms.
card.plain: It spots the end of a Spanish-style name where the little word 'de' is about to come.
